outcome: Expression of genes involved with endothelial function
mRNA levels of soluble fms-like tyrosine kinase-1
cohort: Maternal adipose tissue samples were collected from women undergoing caesarean section, including those with preeclampsia and those with normal pregnancies.
finding: Maternal endothelial cells from preeclamptic patients exhibit extensive alteration of expression of factors associated with antiangiogenic and vasoconstrictive phenotypes.
cross-section timing: Tissue sampled at the time of caesarean section
